title: Multi-Instance Shell Framework For Composable Apps
description: Refactor the framework so multiple FrameworkOsShell instances can coexist on one HTML page without iframes: per-shell theme/appearance/brand, locale (i18next per-shell instance), keybinding dispatch gated to the active shell, element-id resolution scoped to the shell root instead of document-wide, plugin WASM runtime with refcounted module leases and per-document backbone routing (replacing the single global relay slot), namespaced storage, and a per-shell portal layer replacing document.body portals. Also make the wgpu (Rust/Trunk) renderer canvas-parameterized and disposable (mount/unmount) instead of a module-top-level boot hardcoded to #root. Then rebuild the mit-bestand demonstrator (♻️mit-bestand/🧺️demonstrator/) as ONE page with six live, interactive FrameworkOsShell instances (replacing the current six pointer-events-none iframes) with registry-driven pane config, a sequential warm-boot queue, and expand-in-place focus (no navigation to standalone pages; deep links via #<pane> hash). This directly resolves the DEMONSTRATOR-2X3-GRID follow-up ("get all six app panes loading end to end instead of white empty iframes") by eliminating the iframe approach entirely, and is the general composability mechanism for apps appearing together on one page (per goal: Apps within sketchpad, issue #355). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/apps-must-be-designed-soft-kurzweil.md — 8 waves: (0) ShellScope skeleton + multi-shell dev harness, (1) plugin runtime refcounted leases + per-document backbone routing, (2) theme/appearance/CSS container-scoping, (3) element-id scoping + portal layer, (4) keyboard gating + misc singleton scoping, (5) per-shell i18n + storage namespacing, (6) wgpu multi-mount rewrite, (7) demonstrator rebuild + dead-code cleanup.
summary:
Refactored the framework so multiple `FrameworkOsShell` instances coexist on one HTML page without iframes, and rebuilt the mit-bestand demonstrator on top of it (8 waves, per the plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/apps-must-be-designed-soft-kurzweil.md).

## Mechanism (`ShellScope`, one per mounted shell)
- **Plugin runtime**: refcounted `PluginModuleLease`s replacing the single unref'd cache; per-document backbone routes (`registerPluginBackboneRoute`) replacing the single global relay slot; generated plugin bridges instantiate apps with a `crypto.randomUUID()` instance id so co-hosted shells get distinct WASM instances.
- **Theme/CSS**: all `:root`/`.dark` rules in UI_CSS become `.semio-scope`-scoped; `createUiThemeScope(root)` replaces the `applyUiThemeToDocument` singleton; `SurfaceChromeScope` per shell.
- **Element ids**: logical ids stamped via `data-element-id` instead of `id`; `elementIdSelector` resolves against the shell's own root, not `document`.
- **Portals**: per-shell portal layer (`scope.portalLayerRef`) replacing `document.body` targets (Radix `<Select>` still portals to `document.body` directly — a known gap, noted but out of scope, see below).
- **Keyboard**: one page-level document keydown dispatcher gated to the active shell (`useShellKeydown`/`registerShellActivityRoot`) replacing unconditional `window`/`document` listeners.
- **i18n**: per-shell `createInstance()` via `createShellI18nInstance`, resolved automatically by `useTranslation()` through the nearest `I18nextProvider` — zero call-site changes needed.
- **Storage**: explicit `StoragePort` injection (`createBrowserStoragePort`/`createScopedStoragePort`) replacing implicit `localStorage` access; all `readStoredUiChrome*`/`writeStoredUiChrome*` now take a `storage` param.
- **wgpu**: `semio_renderer_boot` → `semio_wgpu_mount(canvas, plugins, pluginFilter)` — caller-owned canvas instead of a hardcoded `#root` lookup, disposable mount.
- Added `suppressAutoIntroduction` to `FrameworkOsShellProps`: the old `window.self !== window.top` iframe-boundary heuristic for gating auto-played onboarding no longer applies once multiple shells share one document: without it every pane auto-played its own introduction the instant it booted, even while backgrounded/inert in the demonstrator's overview grid.

## Demonstrator rebuild
`♻️mit-bestand/🧺️demonstrator/` rewritten end to end: `🟦️brand.ts` gained `DEMONSTRATOR_PANES` (6 panes); `📦️index.tsx` replaced six `pointer-events-none` cross-port iframes with six live `FrameworkOsShell`s in one page (sequential warm-boot queue, overview ⇄ expand-in-place focus via click/`#<pane>` hash, `Übersicht` return, `suppressAutoIntroduction={!focused}`); `📜️script.ts` builds all 6 panes' plugins/engine WASM in-process instead of shelling out per-variant; `⚙️vite.config.ts` mirrors os-dev's config scoped to the union of the 6 variants.

## This session's fix + verification
User reported (live browser error): `Failed to resolve import "@semio-tech/puzzle-2d-rs/pkg/puzzle_2d.js"`. Root cause: the demonstrator's `⚙️vite.config.ts` mirrored os-dev's vite config but omitted `playgroundFlowWasmDevStubPlugin(repoRoot)` (which os-dev includes specifically to stub unresolvable `.../pkg/*.js`/`.wasm` engine imports, since the engine-loader map is statically analyzed by Vite regardless of active variant). Added the plugin. Confirmed fixed via two independent fresh page loads (single `navigate` nav entry each, not HMR) — zero "Failed to resolve" console messages, network shows the import resolving to the stub worker instead.

Full flow re-verified live end to end against the user's own dev server at :6029: overview grid (6 live shells, no iframes) → click pane → expands in place, inert removed → pane's own introduction plays (gated correctly by focus) → "Übersicht" → clean return to overview.

Three pre-existing/external console items were investigated and confirmed non-blocking, not regressions from this work (full trace in `wave7-e2e-verification.txt`): (1) `setActiveExample`/etc. "typed command channel" dispatch failures — an external, in-progress Rust/WASM migration with zero corresponding TS-side implementation, already present before this refactor per the closed DEMONSTRATOR-2X3-GRID ticket; (2) transient `Invalid N panel layout` errors from react-resizable-panels' internal `<Group>` validation, self-healed by the existing `ShellRenderErrorBoundary`, traced to the window-manager dock-layout code (already per-instance state, not a cross-shell leak); (3) a `createRoot()` double-invocation dev warning traced to a failed Vite Fast-Refresh HMR invalidation triggered by concurrent-session edits elsewhere in the import graph — harmless and not present on a quiescent load.

## Known residual gap (documented, not fixed this ticket)
Radix `<Select>` portals to `document.body` directly, bypassing the new per-shell portal layer and `inert` scoping entirely — a real architectural gap for any component using `document.body`-targeted portals rather than the framework's own portal primitive. Not blocking the verified demonstrator flow; flagged for follow-up.
